review_method: Actual rendered screenshots opened and inspected by the publication agent, alongside automated layout checks.

screenshots.observed: Readable title and scope, visible replay links, coherent article sidebar and body.
Mobile guide heading, source identity and download controls fit; no clipped navigation.
No-JavaScript guide retains its source, kit, Markdown and inspection caveat with mobile wrapping.
Reviewed-contract count and source-only distinction are visible; full-card guide links form a readable three-column grid.
Comparator lesson and its scope are readable; replay controls and article navigation are visible.
Legacy reader offers the no-JavaScript index and exact HTML version; button labels wrap without page overflow.

scope: Six specific screenshot viewports, not a visual inspection of every historical artifact or every page position. No full accessibility certification.
